Name: Pigeons and Doves
Author: rangerkatt
Description:
Hi!
I wanted pigeons in my game but no one had made one so I made this for myself.
I made white doves and rock pigeons and all you have to do is replace the White Chicken.xnb and BabyWhite Chicken.xnb in your Stardew Valley Animals folder.
Thought I'd share since I even got them to do the head bob.

If you'd like to see more kinds of pigeons or even a different birb let me know and I might try it.

Downloads.Description: Change your white chickens to Pigeons

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
